name: drawing-scale-game
description: Technical foundation for an online multiplayer drawing game.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names shared,server,client --prefix-colors yellow,blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=@drawing-game/shared" "npm run dev --workspace=@drawing-game/server" "npm run dev --workspace=@drawing-game/client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@drawing-game/shared && npm run build --workspace=@drawing-game/server && npm run build --workspace=@drawing-game/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@drawing-game/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@drawing-game/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@drawing-game/client
